proposedNewSkills.description: Recognition and measurement of assets and liabilities — initial vs subsequent measurement, cost vs fair value, impairment. Proposed for M1-W2; not in seed taxonomy but distinct from financial-statements (structure) and fair-value (measurement basis).
Integrated reporting framework (<IR>), six capitals, connectivity of financial and non-financial information, sustainability disclosures (GRI/SASB/ISSB). Needed for M1-W4 and M12-W4.
Internal pricing between responsibility centers (market-based, cost-based, negotiated). Needed for M3-W2; distinct from decision-analysis and performance-mgmt.
ERP/JCS data architecture, sub-ledger to GL posting, ledger reconciliation across systems. Needed for M6-W1 and M6-W4; distinct from it-governance.
Corporate restructuring, mergers and acquisitions, international finance basics. Needed for M8-W4.
ASC 815 hedge accounting — fair value vs cash flow hedges, effectiveness testing, OCI treatment. Needed for M10-W3; distinct from risk-mgmt.
Real options in capital investment decisions — option to expand, abandon, defer; binomial and Black-Scholes intuition. Needed for M11-W4.
